card.name: Academic field words in institute names
card.fires_on: The last word of a scientific or scholarly field term, such as an adjective ending or the noun after a modifier. It appears in institute names, method names and discipline names, e.g. 'Brain Research', 'molecular genetic', 'mass spectrometric'.
